tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dam can chos rgyal 'khor bcas kyi rjes gnang gi spyi bshad mdor bsdus bzhugs so// na maḥssaṅgu ru pā da ya/ 'dir dam can chos kyi rgyal po 'khor bcas kyi rjes gnang bsgrub pa la/ sngon 'gro slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams grub rjes rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dbang thob pa'i dam tshig dang ldan zhing nang gshin pa bcu gcig tshun ji ltar rig pa khrus byas/ me tog bkye bsdu grub nas/ slob dpon gyis zang zing la mi blta ba'i snying rje dang / lha'i nga rgyal brtan pa dang ldan pa'i sgo nas 'di skad ces brjod do/ /'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya ba dang / gnas skabs su dam pa'i chos sgrub pa la 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi bar byed pa'am/ sel bar byed pa'i ched du dam can chos kyi rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa'i rjes su gnang ba zab mo zhus la/ dam tshig dang sdom pa la bsrung sdom tshul bzhin du bgyi'o snyam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan 'tshal/ de la rang re chos sgrub pa la bdud rigs kyi bar chad nyer 'tshe du ma 'byung bar gsungs te/ sher phyin sdud pa las/ rin chen chos kyang dkon la rtag tu 'tshe ba'ang mang / /zhes sogs/ mdo rgyud bstan bcos rnams las rgya cher gsungs so/ /de yang gang zag rab la ni bar chad kyi mi tshugs la/ las dang po pa dad brtson dang ldan pa'i lam nyams su len pa rnams la 'byung ste/ 'jam dpal rnam par 'phrul ba'i mdo las kyang / mi brtson pa la ni bdud kyi ci zhig bya ste/ de nyid bdud yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes so/ /bar chad kyi rtags ni/ tshe 'di'i rnyed bkur sogs 'dod pa yin te/ de la brten nas thos bsam bsgom pa la mi brtson pa dang / chags sdang rgyas shing chos la sems zhum pa dang / 'jig rten gyi bya ba cher 'bar ba sogs 'byung bar bshad do/ /bar chad kyi tshul ni lha'i bu'i bdud ces pa 'phral rnyed bkur sogs 'phel ba ltar byas nas chos la bar du gcod/

nyon mongs pa'i bdud 'dod chags zhe sdang sogs rang dbang med par skye/ phung po'i bdud na tsha sdug bsngal bskyed/ 'chi bdag gi bdud srog rtsa la zhugs nas bar du gcod par byed do/ /bar chad de rnams zhi bar byed pa'i thabs la gnyis las/ dang po thabs kyi sgo nas zhi bar bya ba ni/ bdud las rnam rgyal/ bar du gcod pa'i bdud rnams kyang / /gnyen po byang chub sems mchog gis/ /zhi ba chen po'i ngang du bzlog /zhes pa'i tshu gyis chos brgyad dor nas/ dam tshig dang sdom pa la gnas pas/ phrag dog la sogs pa rnams spangs nas byang chub kyi sems gtso bor bsgom pa'am/ yang na bsrung ba'i 'khor lo sngags mdud sogs kyi sgo nas sel bar byed dgos pa yin no/ /gnyis pa shes rab kyis sgo nas zhi bar byed pa ni/ rang sems 'khrul pa'i dbang gis med pa la yod par 'dzin pa'i dgra 'drer snang ba la sogs pa rnams bar chad yin zhing / de nyid rang gis ngo bos stong zhing spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba blos cir yang mi bzung ba de kho na nyid kyi ngang las ma bcos par bzhag pa ni don dam pa'i bsrung ba'o/ /'dir snga ma ltar thabs kyi sgo nas srung ba byed pa la/ chos skyong khyad 'phags re bsten dgos/ de la 'jig rten pa'i srung ma dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i srung ma gnyis las/ dang po ni/ pho lha mo lha zhang lha sogs brten kyang tshe 'dir 'gal rkyen bar chad phra mo tsam sel ba dang / mthun rkyen cung zad sgrub nus kyang / mthar thug byang chub ma thob kyis bar gyis 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi ba dang / mthun rkyen byang chub sgrub par mi nus pas bsten kyang don chung ba yin te/ rgyal sras sems dpa' chen po/ rang nyid 'khor ba'i brtson rar bcings gyur na/ /'jig rten lha yi su zhig skyobs par nus/ /zhes snying rje'i bsam pas gtor ma re tsam ster ba ma gtogs bsten cing srung skyob byed pa'i lha ma yin te/

skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya dang 'gal bar mdo las bshad/ gnyis pa 'jig rten las 'das pa'i srung ma la yang / phar phyin gyi srung ma ni dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga sogs te/ de rnams bsten na don grub par bshad/ 'dir de las khyad par du 'phags pa'i rdo rje theg pa nas gsungs pa'i srung ma re bsten dgos/ de la rgyud sde bzhi'i srung ma mang du yod pa las/ 'dir rnal 'byor bla med kyi bsrungs ma yin/ de la thabs shes gnyis med gsum las/ 'dir thabs rgyud yin/ de la pha rgyud sde gsum du grags pa las/ 'dir gshin rje'i gshed skor yin/ de la dmar nag 'jigs gsum las/ 'dir rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bka' bsrung thun mong ma yin pa dam can chos kyi rgyal po 'khor bcas kyi rjes gnang sgrub pa'i skabs su babs pa yin/ 'di la rgyud yongs su ma bsgyur ba'i dbang du byas nas 'jig rten gyi 'chi bdag gshin rje rang rgyud pa'i lo rgyus dang / rgyud yongs su bsgyur ba 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gshin rje'i gshed kyi lo rgyus gnyis las/ dang po ni/ la li ta badzras mdzad pa'i las gshin gyi sgrub thabs las/ shi ba yi dwags rgyal po ni/ /'chi bdag bdud ces bya ba ste/ /'gro rnams kun gyi las kyi bdud/ /lus dang grib ma'i tshul bzhin du/ /'gro ba kun la snang ba ste/ /phung po nying 'tshams sbyor ba yis/ /'jigs pa de yis gzugs mthong nas/ /gshin rje de yis dri ngan 'byung / /des na rang gi srog gis bdag /ltag pa'i phyogs na gnas pa ste/ /gtsigs pa can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs shing / 'chi ba yi dwags rgyal po ni/ /ma dros mtsho yis 'bri mig nas/ /ri nag dgu yi pha mtha' ste/ /spos ngad ri bo'i bar dag na/ /'chu dang zheng du cha mnyam mtsho/ /de 'og dpag tshad lnga brgya'i 'og /'chi ba yi dwags rgyal po'i gnas/ /'gro ba'i bltag pa'i phyogs na gnas/ /zhes gsungs pas/ phyi'i gnas ni mtsho ma dros pa'i 'og dpag tshad lnga brgya'i sa na yod cing /

nang du skye 'gro'i ltag khung du gnas pa/ lus dang grib ma'i tshul du gnas pa/ phung po nying 'tshams sbyor ba'i tshe/ 'chi bdag tu 'gyur ba yin la/ gnyis pa rgyud yongs su bsgyur ba 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gshin rje gshed kyi lo rgyus ni/ sngon rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud gsungs pa'i tshe/ gdul bya thun mong ba 'jig rten gyi dregs pa can thams cad btul/ de nas lho phyogs kyi rgya mtsho las brgal te gshin (ma dpe la yig phreng gcig mi gsal)des na 'jig rten pa'i gshin rje rang rgyud pa dang 'khrul bar mi bya'o/ /de ltar na 'chi bdag gi gnyen po yin pas chos skyong 'di shin tu zab pa yin no/ /de lta bu'i rjes su gnang ba sgrub pa la/ sngon 'gro slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams grub nas/ khyed rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la thog mar slob dpon la bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed dngos yin snyam pas rjes su gnang ba zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇḍal phul nas snyim pa me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa ni 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ zhes sogs thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis yig cha ltar bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di yang don gnyer 'ga' yi bskul nas/ dā ri dra pa sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis so// //sarba maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ dam can chos rgyal 'khor bcas kyi rjes gnang gi spyi bshad mdor bsdus/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
